user.description: Set up your Bond hub. The local token is shown in the Bond app under your bridge's settings, or fetched automatically within 10 minutes of power-cycling the bridge.

confirm.description: Do you want to set up {name} ({host})?

reauth_confirm.description: The token for the Bond hub at {host} is no longer valid. Enter the current local token to reconnect.

reconfigure.description: Update the connection settings for this Bond hub.

set_light_brightness_tracked_state.name: Set light brightness tracked state
